name: Ai ni Kuruiochi Akai Ito
source:
"We can see the red thread. It is forbidden to tell a third party who you are tied to."

A story of five pairs of men and women in a world where you can see the red thread.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7440]NovelGame[/url]]
